notes: Read all 91 source lines (numbered) before editing. The module is a side-effect-only component, mounted once from <Layout>, that builds informational ShortcutDefinitions and pours them into the shortcut registry via useShortcut(defs), rendering nothing (return null). It has no JSX despite the .tsx extension. Three of its inputs are browser-coupled and ported behind established native-parity conventions; the rest is pure JS that runs identically under Hermes.

L1 `import { useMemo } from 'react'` -> `import {useCallback, useMemo} from 'react'` (react is RN-compatible; native prettier drops inner-brace spacing; useMemo still used for `defs`, useCallback added for the i18n fallback shim).

L2 `import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next'` REMOVED — react-i18next is not a native dependency (not installed). Replaced by the local `useNativeTranslationFallback()` shim (the PageHeader / RangeSlider / Breadcrumbs precedent) declared with type `NativeTFunction = (key, fallback, values?: {label?: string}) => string`; it returns the English fallback verbatim and resolves `{{label}}` via `fallback.replace(/\{\{(\w+)\}\}/g, ...)`, preserving every i18n key.

L3 `import { GOTO_SHORTCUTS } from '@/hooks/useKeyboardShortcuts'` -> `import {GOTO_SHORTCUTS} from '../hooks/useKeyboardShortcuts'` (relative path to the already-ported native hook; the @/ alias is not configured in the native tsconfig — no compilerOptions.paths). All 14 GOTO rows are preserved byte-for-byte in that port.

L4 `import { useShortcut, type ShortcutDefinition } from '@/hooks/useShortcutRegistry'` -> `import {useShortcut, type ShortcutDefinition} from '../hooks/useShortcutRegistry'` (relative path to the native useShortcutRegistry port, a pure-JS external store). The `type` modifier on ShortcutDefinition is preserved.

The array is the faithful projection of `commandRegistry.filter(c => c.shortcut)` — the three default commands declaring a shortcut, copied verbatim: pref.themePicker/palette.cmd.themePicker/'Open theme picker'/'T', action.shortcuts/palette.cmd.shortcuts/'Show keyboard shortcuts'/'?', action.dashboard.edit/palette.cmd.dashboardEdit/'Edit dashboard layout'/'E'.
